source.author: Staff Sgt. Lucretia Cunningham
source.interpretation: Visually stationary afterburning test-cell engine; no claim this is idle, a clean-room measurement, or onboard cabin sound

recipe.mono: Arithmetic mean: 0.5L + 0.5R; no equal-power downmix gain
recipe.loop: Long smoothstep-phase equal-power tail/head overlap with natural consecutive-source wrap; circular EQ/high-pass; quiet-boundary rotation <=10ms
recipe.highpass: 24 Hz, second-order Butterworth, applied with circular frequency-response convolution
recipe.dc: Mean removed from source and final floating-point loops before PCM quantization
recipe.dither: Deterministic PCG64-seeded TPDF at +/-1 PCM16 LSB before round-to-nearest quantization
recipe.dynamics: No compressor, limiter, clipper, master normalization or automatic peak gain; C has one explicitly measured quiet parallel-body gain

selected_candidate.intent: Reference texture; DC cleanup and 24 Hz high-pass only.

assets.scope: Edited audio texture used only for afterburner. Other sound layers are authored synthesis. No visual material is embedded.
